title: Testing and classroom delivery
goal: Record a safe release decision with test and rollback evidence.
case: A new policy-assistant version sometimes exposes a staff-only passage.
terms: Require evidence that inputs, permissions, output and failure handling meet a defined threshold.
Log enough to debug while omitting unnecessary personal data and credentials.
Restore a previously tested configuration if a new version fails.
All run costs including failed attempts divided by successful tasks; undefined at zero success.
steps: Run approved and unauthorized access cases
Simulate a missing source and bad input
Reject a bad candidate version and restore the prior config
example: Version 1 blocks staff policy for student role.
Release is blocked and version 1 remains active.
misconception: A high answer accuracy can compensate for an access-control failure.
correction: Access is a release gate. Report accuracy and security outcomes separately.
change: Flip the candidate role check and verify rollback happens.
metric: Passed release gates / required gates; cost per successful task
lab: Run a local release-gate simulation and rollback.
output: Filtered trace and classroom release checklist.
